{{Infobox auto}}

'''French toast''' is a filling [[bread]] dish that heals {{Value|French Toast|heals}} and has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/french_toast.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
An egg, sugar, estus ash and bread (or [[naan]]). Obtaining bread unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating French toast takes {{Value|French Toast|eat_time}} and heals {{Value|French Toast|heals}}.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_12.mcfunction}}</ref>
